sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Media Protection Policy defines rules for protecting physical and digital media containing Controlled Unclassified Information within {system_name} operated by {org_name}. It applies to the boundary {boundary} covering {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Physical Control and Secure Storage of Media

questions.prompt: How is paper media containing CUI physically controlled?
How is digital media containing CUI physically controlled?
How is paper media containing CUI securely stored?
How is digital media containing CUI securely stored?

sections.body: Paper media containing CUI is physically controlled via {paper_physical_control}. Digital media containing CUI is physically controlled via {digital_physical_control}. Paper media is securely stored in {paper_secure_storage}. Digital media is securely stored in {digital_secure_storage}.

sections.heading: 3. Media Access Control

questions.prompt: How is access to CUI on system media limited to authorized users?

sections.body: Access to CUI on system media is restricted strictly to authorized users through {media_access_limitation}.

sections.heading: 4. Media Sanitization and Disposal

questions.prompt: How is media containing CUI sanitized or destroyed before disposal?
How is media containing CUI sanitized before release for reuse?

sections.body: Prior to disposal system media containing CUI is sanitized or destroyed according to {media_sanitization_disposal}. Media released for reuse is sanitized following {media_sanitization_reuse}.
